cover.why: no step in TLC's graph is a reader action

classes.end: 无效编码或损坏事件：请求已结清，返回成功
classes.rule: Invalid UTF-8 or JSON is not concealed by a later DONE (services/llm.rs:1919; stream_decode.rs:20).
classes.fix: 无效编码或损坏事件：识别为故障

classes.end: 成功状态携带错误：请求已结清，返回成功
classes.rule: A failed provider envelope cannot be returned as a successful answer (services/llm.rs:1024).
classes.fix: 成功状态携带错误：识别为故障

classes.end: 正常回复含空错误字段：请求已结清，错误拒绝正常回复
classes.rule: A completed response with a null error field remains successful (services/llm/failure.rs:102).
classes.fix: 正常回复含空错误字段：准备返回结果

classes.end: 永久拒绝含误导正文：请求已结清，错误触发上下文恢复
classes.rule: A permanent provider code takes priority over misleading message text (orchestrator/llm.rs:1335).
classes.fix: 永久拒绝含误导正文：请求已结清，明确永久拒绝

classes.end: 中文跨网络分块：请求已结清，文字或参数已损坏
classes.rule: Split network chunks do not change the successful text or tool arguments (stream_decode.rs:9).
classes.fix: 中文跨网络分块：请求已结清，返回成功
